title: Will I get a receipt for my purchase?
content: Yes — Stripe (our payment processor) automatically emails you a receipt when your card is charged. Check the email address you used at checkout, including your spam/promotions folder if it doesn't show up within a few minutes.

title: I think I was charged twice — what do I do?
content: Morechard has safeguards to stop the same purchase from being granted to your account twice, even if a payment gets processed more than once on our end. If you genuinely see two separate charges on your bank/card statement for the same purchase, email support@morechard.com with both transaction details and we'll sort out a refund for the duplicate.

title: Can I upgrade from Core AI to Shield AI later?
content: Yes. Whether you started on Core or Core AI (or the AI Mentor upgrade), whatever you already paid is credited toward Shield AI's price — you only pay the difference, not the full amount again.

title: What payment methods does Morechard accept?
content: Card payments only, processed securely through Stripe. We don't currently support Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, or bank transfer for purchasing a Morechard plan.

title: Can I change our currency after signing up?
content: Yes — the lead parent can change the family's currency later from settings; it isn't locked in permanently at sign-up. Past chores, goals, and ledger entries keep the currency they were originally recorded in and aren't converted retroactively — only new activity uses the new currency going forward.

title: Can I remove one child from our account without deleting everything?
content: Not currently — there's no way to delete a single child's profile on its own while keeping the rest of the family account. The only account-level deletion available is closing the entire family account, which removes every profile on it. If this is something you need, contact support and we can talk through your options.

title: Is Morechard free?
content: Morechard has a full-featured 14-day free trial — no card required to start, and every feature (including AI Mentor) is unlocked during it. After the trial, continuing to use the app requires a one-time purchase starting at £44.99 — there's no free-forever tier.

title: How much does Morechard cost?
content: Morechard is a one-time purchase, not a subscription: Core is £44.99, Core AI (adds AI Mentor + Learning Lab) is £64.99, and Shield AI (adds forensic-tier court-ready exports) is £149.99. If you already own Core, adding AI Mentor later costs £29.99.
